notes: Skeleton file. Run Actions -> populate-manifest to fill meshes/bones/materials/up_axis/height_m automatically, or type the exact names in by hand. worker.py tolerates empty arrays (it fuzzy-matches names) but the LLM cannot reference names it cannot see. up_axis: auto detects from bounding box; pin to X/Y/Z if detection picks wrong. shape_key_edit:false makes vertex ops skip meshes that have blend shapes instead of distorting the morph targets.
